evidence.summary: CASI reports that the university’s School of Physics and Advanced Technology Institute co-hosted a 2018 bilateral symposium on numerical simulation and computational physics with the Institute of Fluid Physics of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP), China’s nuclear-weapons complex, whose national defence key laboratory for shockwave and blast physics was among the hosts.

Chongqing University describes itself as a national key university under central management and directly under the Ministry of Education; its charter says it is founded by the state and supervised by the education ministry.
